text_markup: Some "install and rez" abilities affect more than 1 card. In this case, each card is rezzed directly after it is installed, as part of the same instruction and before the next installation begins. See also {ref:rule_install_one_at_a_time}.
text_plain: Some "install and rez" abilities affect more than 1 card. In this case, each card is rezzed directly after it is installed, as part of the same instruction and before the next installation begins. See also rule 8.5.5.
